body_prompt_plan.json.idle_prompt:
Use case: historical-scene. Native transparent 2D game sprite atlas: EXACTLY FOUR separate full-body views of the SAME young Shi En in a strict equal 2 by 2 grid. No grid lines, captions or text.
Identity image 1 is the canonical portrait: fair Chinese man age24–25, recognizable angular face, modest black moustache and three thin black beard locks, dark teal plain headcloth and bun, plain blue-green cloth robe with ivory inner collar. NO armor, metal fittings, paired batons, poison motifs or tattoos.
Image 2 is ONLY the old game's four-view CAMERA, hand-painted realism, relative framing and transparent layout reference. Completely replace its armor, bracers, leather boots and two short weapons with the canonical CLOTH outfit from image1.
Full-body clothing: simple knee-length cross-wrapped blue-green robe with tied plain cloth belt, dark gray loose trousers and simple dark cloth shoes. No helmet, armor, jewels or rank insignia. A SINGLE long smooth unadorned brown WOODEN STAFF, held in both hands as practical staff-fighting training equipment; no spear point, gold caps or second stick. Staff is a conservative gameplay choice from the novel's small spear/staff skill, not a claimed exact artifact. Healthy state, no white injury bandage or sling.
Camera and directions: top-left FRONT THREE-QUARTER FACING SCREEN RIGHT (SE); top-right FRONT THREE-QUARTER FACING SCREEN LEFT (SW); bottom-left BACK THREE-QUARTER FACING SCREEN RIGHT (NE); bottom-right BACK THREE-QUARTER FACING SCREEN LEFT (NW). Camera looks slightly down at about30degrees, vertical figures, same zoom and body scale in every cell. Do not repeat a front view in a rear cell.
Layout: square canvas, each figure completely within its own quadrant, at least24pixels clear alpha gutters to all cell edges. Head near 12% of its cell height, shoe soles on the common baseline at90% of its own cell height; torso centered about the middle of the cell. Keep source framing consistent for future animation sheets. No props crossing cell edges. Include full staff, both shoes and head.
Painterly fine brushwork consistent with reference, clear silhouette at small scale, true transparent alpha background, NO floor, no cast shadow, no checkerboard, no opaque black, no decorative effects.
Pose in all four cells: relaxed balanced ready idle, both feet planted shoulder-width, both hands holding the single staff in a low diagonal guard, not attacking. Show consistent youthful slender physique and three beard wisps where the face is visible.
body_prompt_plan.json.injured_portrait_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the supplied new canonical Shi En portrait into his injured FIRST MEETING in chapter28. Keep exactly the same young fair face, modest moustache and THREE slender black beard locks, same painterly style, head size, square chest-up crop and warm opaque parchment background. Keep plain blue-green gauze-cloth robe and ivory collar. Replace only the dark teal forehead cloth with a plain WHITE cloth handkerchief bound across his forehead, still showing black tied-up hair. Add a plain WHITE SILK ARM SLING running diagonally over the chest, visibly supporting ONE forearm at the lower edge of the portrait; it is an arm support, not a belt or ornamental sash. Mild tired expression, alive and composed; no exaggerated wound or blood. This is a separate injured story outfit, not ordinary battle armor. No armor, weapons, gold, snakes, tattoos, text, borders or watermark.

Produce ONE transparent full-body 2x2 sprite sheet of the SAME Shi En, in exactly the SAME four cells, camera, body scale and outfit as reference1 (canonical idle body). Reference2 is the canonical close-up identity: young fair Chinese24–25, fine moustache and THREE slender black beard wisps. Preserve the blue-green cloth robe, plain belt/headcloth, dark trousers, cloth shoes, single smooth brown wooden staff, same slender physique and same face. No armor, paired weapons, gold, poison, new ornaments or tattoos. Top-left=SE front facing screen RIGHT; top-right=SW front facing screen LEFT; bottom-left=NE back facing screen RIGHT; bottom-right=NW back facing screen LEFT. Four correctly different 3D views, not mirrored copies. Strict equal 2x2 quadrants, whole figure and staff inside each cell with transparent gutters. Same fixed slightly top-down camera, no zoom; standing ground reference at90% cell height with torso near center. Hand-painted realistic game sprite style like reference1.

actions.walk_contact_a: WALK phase1: anatomical LEFT foot forward with heel contacting the floor, RIGHT foot trailing and toe pushing off. Torso upright, single staff held low, natural cloth swing.
actions.walk_passing_a: WALK phase2: weight on LEFT support leg, RIGHT leg lifted and passing alongside to swing forward. Show clear bent lifted knee and separated shoes, no foot sliding.
actions.walk_contact_b: WALK phase3: anatomical RIGHT foot forward with heel contacting, LEFT foot trailing and toe pushing off. This is the opposite contact from phase1, not a duplicate.
actions.walk_passing_b: WALK phase4: weight on RIGHT support leg, LEFT leg lifted and passing forward with bent knee. Opposite passing pose from phase2. Same relaxed healthy walk.
actions.attack_windup: STAFF ATTACK anticipation: both hands grip one plain wooden staff, twist the upper body, rear hand pulls staff back over shoulder in a diagonal preparation, both feet firmly braced. Not a spear with metal tip; no extra sticks.
actions.attack_strike: STAFF ATTACK contact: both hands extend in a decisive diagonal downward staff strike aimed toward the direction each figure faces. Keep entire single brown wooden rod within each cell with clear space, no magic or motion effect.
actions.attack_recover: STAFF ATTACK follow-through and recovery: finish diagonal two-handed staff strike then draw it back toward low guard, torso partly turned, feet balanced. Clearly differs from anticipation and contact; one staff.
actions.hurt_recoil: HURT phase1: standing nonlethal recoil from an ordinary physical hit, torso bends back slightly and shoulders flinch, both hands still keep ONE staff under control. Clothes remain intact, no wounds or glowing effects.
actions.hurt_recover: HURT phase2: recover balance toward upright stance, one small stabilizing step, grip the same single staff. Alive, no kneeling, no blood or injury costume.
actions.death_buckle: ORDINARY FREE-BATTLE DEATH phase1: knees buckle and torso loses strength, head droops, begin falling backward. Both shoes remain near original standing anchor. Single wooden staff loosens in hand. Nongraphic; no blood. This is an optional game combat animation, NOT Shi En's novel drowning.
actions.death_fall: ORDINARY FREE-BATTLE DEATH phase2: halfway falling backward, hips descending, torso tilting back, arms and single wooden staff follow the fall. Keep original character scale and fit whole body/staff into cell; feet near original anchor. No blood.
actions.death_settle: ORDINARY FREE-BATTLE DEATH phase3: body settles onto the ground on back/side, legs bent, eyes shut, single wooden staff fallen beside him, no attempt to get up. No pool of blood or severing. Keep full body with original pixel scale, do not zoom in on horizontal pose.
actions.death_rest: ORDINARY FREE-BATTLE DEATH phase4 terminal: same man lying still on back/side, fully limp with eyes shut, one plain wooden staff resting beside body. Clearly no longer a conscious surrender pose. No blood. Keep same body size/rotation/direction as matching prior fall; no camera changes.

Edit target/reference: the supplied current Shi En portrait. Keep the same individual facial bone structure and painterly game portrait style, but correct the features and costume to the novel, not the old unsupported armor design.
Canonical character: Chinese young man about twenty-four or twenty-five, fair clean skin, youthful face, THREE SLENDER BLACK BEARD LOCKS ("三柳髭须"), with a modest fine black moustache. This is the healthy general portrait, not the injured first-meeting version: no head injury bandage, no arm sling, no blood. Those will have separate state-specific art.
Keep square chest-up framing, full bun comfortably inside the canvas, looking slightly screen right, warm parchment background, painterly realism, light direction and visual density of reference. Opaque background.
Avoid: clean-shaven chin, dense full beard, gray beard, old face, armor, weapons, tattoos, snake scales, poison, jewels, official rank badges, text, watermarks, frames. One person only.
